description: The thorn parts at a frame of welded rail, and the gap is filled by two leaves of plate hung on truck springs. They stand open. A rack beside them holds the masks: bone, horn, welded plate, one of them a drone's faceplate turned inside out, and every single one lined with quilted rag and stitched down at the edges so it won't chafe on a long shift. A tally board hangs under the rack with names against hours in four different hands. Past the gate there's washing on a line.
name: The North Gate
